title: Mother Ayahuasca gives Hancock a novel's plot

tellings.quote: back in 2006 drinking Ayahuasca in Brazil over a series of five sessions I was given literally given the entire plot of a novel

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says that in 2006, over five sessions of drinking ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew from the Amazon, in Brazil, he was "literally given the entire plot of a novel." He tells Michels this as his own experience, and the book that came of it was his novel Entangled. If true, it would mean the visions handed him a finished story rather than mere images.
